id2.desktop: display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; height: fit-content;

n1.desktop: grid-column: span 2 / span 2; grid-row: span 2 / span 2; aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: clip; border-radius: 12px;
n1.mobile: grid-column: span 1 / span 1; grid-row: span 1 / span 1;

n2.desktop: grid-column: span 1 / span 1; grid-row: span 1 / span 1; aspect-ratio: 1.3333; overflow: clip; border-radius: 12px;

n3.desktop: grid-column: span 1 / span 1; grid-row: span 1 / span 1; aspect-ratio: 1.3333; overflow: clip; border-radius: 12px;

n4.desktop: grid-column: span 1 / span 1; grid-row: span 1 / span 1; aspect-ratio: 1.3333; overflow: clip; border-radius: 12px;

n5.desktop: grid-column: span 1 / span 1; grid-row: span 1 / span 1; aspect-ratio: 1.3333; overflow: clip; border-radius: 12px;

n6.desktop: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; padding: 64px;
n6.mobile: grid-template-columns: repeat(1, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding-inline: 16px; padding-block: 24px;
